info.title: Asset ownership reads
info.description: Read-only native owner queries. Existing selection/order and optional versus nullable result semantics retained; mandatory service capability and REAL/DEMO context. Requests bounded to 4096 IDs per collection / 2 MiB, responses to 16 MiB without truncation. No writes or retries.

serviceCapability.description: Dedicated profile-summary read credential; server-only, at least 256 random bits.
